title: Schema Best Practices
description: Apply best practices for designing clean, maintainable, and performant Prisma schemas.

data.text: A well-designed Prisma schema is the foundation of a healthy application. Follow these best practices to keep your schema clean, maintainable, and performant.

items: Use `cuid()` or `uuid()` for public-facing IDs instead of auto-incrementing integers
Add `@updatedAt` to models where tracking changes is important
Use enums for fields with a fixed set of values
Keep models focused on a single responsibility
Use `@@map` to keep table names aligned with your team's conventions
Use `select` and `include` to avoid over-fetching in queries
Avoid circular dependencies in relation fields
Do not use `@default(dbgenerated())` unless you understand the implications
Avoid nullable foreign keys unless the relation is truly optional
Keep the schema file organized with comments for complex sections

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: Treat your schema.prisma as a contract. Changes to the schema should be intentional and reviewed, just like any other API contract in your application.
